title: The Red Rain
text: The sky clouds over, low and bruised, and it rains warm and red. The rain smells of copper. It runs down faces and pools in the folds of cloaks, and it does not wash off.

options.label: Shelter and wait it out; nothing good falls from a sky like that.

outcomes.text: It rains all day. When it stops, the red is still in the creases of your hands.

options.label: Catch it in every flask you have; whatever it is, it is rare.

outcomes.text: In the flask it thickens to something precious, still warm to the touch.

options.label: Someone drinks it, on a dare, to see what the sky is bleeding.

outcomes.text: It burns going down. Their blood runs fast, and the next fight comes faster.
It burns going down, and it does not stop burning.
